degree_requirement.value: Bachelor's degree in Informatics / Computer Science equivalent to the B.Sc. Informatics taught at TUM
degree_requirement.quote: Students with a Bachelor’s degree in Informatics / Computer Science which is equivalent to the B.Sc. Informatics taught at TUM are eligible to apply.

value.min_scores: minimal qualifying score of the respective year

entrance_tests.quote: GRE or Gate score for applicants with a B.Sc. degree from Bangladesh, China, India, Iran, Pakistan (original scorecard or have the score transmitted directly via ETS)

work_experience.quote: This may include demonstration of qualifications which exceed the knowledge and qualifications obtained at undergraduate degree level, e.g. program-related vocational training, internships, stays abroad, research papers etc.

aps_required.quote: Applicants with an undergraduate degree from China, India and Vietnam have to submit a certificate from the German Evaluation Center (APS).

application_route.quote: Applicants who did not obtain their qualification for postgraduate studies (usually a bachelor's degree) in Germany must apply for a preliminary documentation (VPD) from uni-assist, additionally to the TUM application.

deadlines.quote: Application period for winter semester: 01.02. – 31.05. Application period for summer semester: 01.10. – 30.11.

selection_process.value: Two-stage aptitude assessment procedure evaluating bachelor's degree grades, curricular analysis, statement of reasons, and scientific essay; applicants may receive direct admission, rejection, or an invitation to a written test on campus.
selection_process.quote: The aptitude assessment for the M.Sc. Data Engineering and Analytics is a two-stage process in which we assess your qualification with regard to the special qualitative requirements of this Master's program.

value: Bachelor's degree certificate or official transcript of records
GRE or GATE score (for degrees from Bangladesh, China, India, Iran, Pakistan)
Preliminary documentation from uni-assist (VPD) (for degrees from outside Germany)
APS certificate (for degrees from China, Vietnam, India)

tuition_eur_per_semester_non_eu.quote: The tuition fees for international students from third countries for this degree program are 6,000 euros per semester .

language_of_instruction.quote: The language of instruction for this program is usually English.
